rule: a delta with an empty applies_to_experiment_arms is NOT part of any canonical arm; its effect may never be credited to regime work

deltas.before_semantics: module references np without importing numpy and cannot be imported
deltas.after_semantics: the lab adapter imports numpy explicitly; the original bytes are untouched
deltas.reproducer: importing the raw module raises NameError: np
deltas.expected_effect: none on decisions; the alpha simply becomes runnable

deltas.before_semantics: entry booked at the signal close, protective levels derived from it
deltas.after_semantics: close decision then next-open fill; levels derived from the actual fill price
deltas.expected_effect: shifts every entry by one bar and re-prices SL/TP

deltas.before_semantics: an if/elif chain fills at most one TP stage per bar and gates the final TP on both partials
deltas.after_semantics: an explicit ordered ladder evaluates every level a bar actually crossed, in price order
deltas.expected_effect: more complete exits on wide bars; the legacy stage-lock path is retained as legacy_reproduction

deltas.before_semantics: realized-only equity inside the alpha, used as if it were the account
deltas.after_semantics: the engine ledger owns equity; the legacy column is kept as a labelled diagnostic
deltas.expected_effect: removes a mark-to-market blind spot from any objective

deltas.before_semantics: the ATR variable is the absolute close-to-close move and ignores high/low
deltas.after_semantics: a true-range ATR variant, offered as a SEPARATE version
deltas.expected_effect: changes the entry threshold scale; must never be mixed into canonical results

deltas.before_semantics: account configuration (initial_capital, trading_fee, usd_per_trade) lives inside the alpha
deltas.after_semantics: account configuration moves to the experiment-level economic contract, identical for all arms
deltas.expected_effect: removes a per-alpha sizing degree of freedom from the search space

deltas.before_semantics: helpers index past the end of short inputs
deltas.after_semantics: explicit warmup readiness: too-short input yields a valid no-signal state, never a crash and never a silent zero
deltas.expected_effect: no decision change after warmup

deltas.before_semantics: entry at the signal close with levels from that price
deltas.after_semantics: close decision, next-open fill, levels from the actual fill
deltas.expected_effect: shifts entries by one bar

deltas.before_semantics: the time stop is tested before the price stop and the take profit
deltas.after_semantics: a frozen priority: stop, then take profit, then the time stop as a close decision
deltas.expected_effect: changes which exit wins on a bar where both trigger; applied identically to every arm

deltas.before_semantics: the dynamic VWAP exit uses the current bar's completed VWAP as an intrabar level
deltas.after_semantics: exit_at_vwap is OFF in the canonical pilot; when enabled it is the resting previous-observed-VWAP variant, registered before any result is seen
deltas.expected_effect: removes a look-ahead exit; registered ahead of performance, not switched off because a backtest looked bad

deltas.before_semantics: the HTF EMA is joined on the resample label with a trailing ffill
deltas.after_semantics: the join is on available_at from a closed HTF bucket, with warmup convergence from the EMA span rather than a hardcoded 200 bars
deltas.expected_effect: removes any dependence on the resample label convention

deltas.before_semantics: the module default merges the VN30F1M-annotated tete preset
deltas.after_semantics: no default is ever executed; a configuration must be supplied explicitly
deltas.expected_effect: prevents an accidental VN-tuned run

deltas.before_semantics: the comment treats the next open as equal to the current close
deltas.after_semantics: the engine supplies the actual fill; entry-dependent levels are re-derived from it
deltas.expected_effect: levels move whenever the next open gaps

deltas.before_semantics: a single pos_weight array mixes the pre-bar position with intrabar exit events
deltas.after_semantics: separate fields: position_entering_bar and target_after_close, plus a typed exit event
deltas.expected_effect: removes a lag/double-count ambiguity

deltas.before_semantics: the RSI recursion returns 100 whenever avg_loss is zero, even when avg_gain is also zero, while the seed returns 50 in that case
deltas.after_semantics: the flat case stays 50 throughout the recursion, consistent with the seed
deltas.expected_effect: affects only flat segments; applied before any A/B and to every arm identically

deltas.before_semantics: mintick is hardcoded to 0.0001 for every instrument
deltas.after_semantics: the instrument's real tick size is used; the pip buffer keeps the 10x semantics, versioned
deltas.expected_effect: changes the 48-bar high/low buffer per symbol

deltas.before_semantics: min_length > max_length is accepted silently in 4 presets
deltas.after_semantics: the adapter rejects an infeasible configuration instead of swapping the bounds
deltas.expected_effect: those four presets are not runnable as canonical configurations

deltas.before_semantics: time_ms, volume, double_up and sl_mult are carried but never read
deltas.after_semantics: they are dropped from the active search space and recorded as deprecated/ignored
deltas.expected_effect: shrinks the search space without changing any decision

deltas.before_semantics: every kernel runs njit(fastmath=True)
deltas.after_semantics: the reference oracle runs fastmath=False; a fastmath kernel is only accepted when it reproduces the oracle's decisions within the declared tolerance
deltas.expected_effect: no decision change is permitted; a difference blocks the kernel

deltas.before_semantics: the indicator choice and the method dispatch disagree when volume is absent
deltas.after_semantics: use_rsi is resolved once and both the construction and the call follow it; the crypto primary path requires volume and a missing column is an explicit rejection
deltas.expected_effect: removes an AttributeError path; no decision change when volume is present

deltas.before_semantics: execution consumes the unapproved signals while the approved ones are computed and dropped
deltas.after_semantics: one declared decision timestamp with a next-open fill; no second shift is applied
deltas.expected_effect: fixes the intent timing without changing the signal definition

deltas.before_semantics: position amplitude is 2 with no account contract attached
deltas.after_semantics: direction is normalised to 0/1 against the fixed experiment notional as sizing_mapping_v1; the legacy amplitude path is a separate labelled reproduction
deltas.expected_effect: 2 is never interpreted as 2x leverage

deltas.before_semantics: the internal MFI/RSI threshold is named regime_threshold
deltas.after_semantics: it is namespaced alpha.condition_threshold; external market state uses a different namespace
deltas.expected_effect: prevents an internal indicator threshold being read as a regime-model output

deltas.before_semantics: the zero-seeded trend emits a spurious buy_signal on the first condition-true bar
deltas.after_semantics: warmup_ready stays False until 3 bars after the trend leaves its seed, so the seed jump and its comparison window can never produce a decision
deltas.expected_effect: removes one manufactured entry per series; identical treatment for every arm

deltas.before_semantics: the cross formula compares trend[t] vs trend[t-2] and trend[t-1] vs trend[t-2]
deltas.after_semantics: a conventional crossover(trend, trend.shift(2)) is available as a research revision only
deltas.expected_effect: changes the signal definition, so it is never mixed into canonical results
